subject: Mid-quarter readiness: QBR materials, infra dependencies, and scope proposals
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter readiness: QBR materials, infra dependencies, and scope proposals

Team —

As we hit the midpoint of the quarter I want to get a tight readout for the QBR (two weeks out). Key asks below — please reply with owners and ETA by EOD Wed. I put a draft QBR deck in the Drive link (attached v1).

1) Quick OKR snapshot (one-liners):
   - Cost / unit economics (OKR-1): on-track for model comp savings but forecast shows 12% over target without further quantization.
   - Latency SLO (OKR-2): P95 tail still at 420ms on edge region; needs targeted routing tweaks.
   - Reliability / Rollouts (OKR-3): Canary pipeline ready; some test flakiness on nightly runs.

2) Scope trim proposals (pick one option by Wed):
   - Option A (conservative): Defer multi-tenant KV cache improvements to next quarter; prioritize batching + quantization.
   - Option B (aggressive): Keep KV work, delay noncritical tracing enhancements; expect +3 SRE days/week for two weeks.

3) Infra/dependency asks (owners + ETA):
   - Production SRE allocation for latency routing experiment (need 2 SRE-days/week x 2 weeks) — owner: Vivek?
   - SOC2 evidence list currently outstanding from Infra (see attached spreadsheet) — owner: Marcus to confirm items by Thu.
   - CloudOps partner to validate our new reserved instance configs for Dedicated clusters — owner: Aditya to coordinate with CloudOps.

4) QBR prep: slide deck draft in Drive; please add one slide each (owner, status, top risk, ask). External stakeholders (Acme) want a short sync during our QBR week — confirm availability.

Attachments: QBR_draft_v1.pptx, SOC2_evidence_request.xlsx, dependency_matrix.csv

Thanks — short bullets preferred in replies.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter readiness: QBR materials, infra dependencies, and scope proposals

Neha —

I can cover the SRE allocation. Committing 2 SRE-days/week for the next two weeks for the routing experiment (INFRA-4123). High level plan:
- Day 1: baseline routing metrics capture + rollback plan tested.
- Day 3-10: iterate on policy (region pinning + cache warming).

On scope trims: I prefer Option A (defer KV improvements). The KV rollout currently risks introducing instability into the canary path. Option A preserves latency work and quantization which directly moves the needle on OKR-1 and OKR-2.

I'll update the dependency_matrix.csv with confirmed SRE owners by EOD Tue.

-Vivek
Sr. Engineering Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter readiness: QBR materials, infra dependencies, and scope proposals

Quick notes from infra/model onboarding POV:

- Quantization experiments look promising in staging (7–9% unit-cost reduction) but we need a controlled AB over 2 weeks to validate production effect. Recommend we run the quantized variant as a canary with 5% traffic ramp. Owner: Aditya (I'll run with SRE).
- For CloudOps verification: I'll schedule the partner call with CloudOps Partner (cc'ed) for Wed 14:00 PT to confirm reserved instance behavior and autoscaling thresholds. CloudOps has requested the dependency_matrix.csv and the list of instance types we plan to use.
- On SOC2 evidence: Marcus, please confirm the S3 logging retention policy; the auditor flagged missing retention dates earlier.

Option B trade: if leadership picks Option B, we'll need 3 SRE-days/week for two weeks plus a one-week pause on noncritical deploys to stabilize canaries.

-Aditya
Infrastructure Product Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme CS <cs@acme.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter readiness: QBR materials, infra dependencies, and scope proposals

Neha —

Thanks for the update and for including Acme. We can join a short slot during QBR week for the product readout — Tue or Wed morning PT works for our execs (Sarah + one engineer). We are especially interested in the latency SLO plan and the quantization AB; will that impact the SLA/ingestion behavior we see today?

From our side: Acme CS will provide current production call traces and latency percentiles by EOD Fri to help reproduce the hotspot. Sending those as CSV (will attach to the HubSpot ticket).

-Sarah
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter readiness: QBR materials, infra dependencies, and scope proposals

Thanks all — quick summary / decisions so we have a single source of truth: 

Decisions:
- SRE allocation: Vivek confirmed 2 SRE-days/week x 2 weeks for routing experiment (INFRA-4123).
- Scope: Leadership selects Option A — defer KV cache improvements. We will focus on batching/quantization and targeted routing.
- Quantization: Aditya to run a 5% canary AB and report results after two weeks.
- SOC2 items: Marcus to confirm S3 retention and upload missing docs to the SOC2 spreadsheet by Thu morning.
- External: Acme will share traces by Fri; they and CloudOps will join a 30-minute alignment during QBR week (Tue 10:00 PT — calendar invite pending).

Action owners (owner — deliverable — ETA):
- Vivek — routing experiment plan + baseline metrics — 2026-10-16
- Aditya — AB plan + instance list for CloudOps — 2026-10-13 (partner call Wed 14:00 PT)
- Marcus — SOC2 spreadsheet updates & S3 retention confirmation — 2026-10-15 10:00 PT
- Neha — finalize QBR deck, consolidate one-slide updates, and send external invite — 2026-10-15 EOD

I'll update the Drive deck with a one-slide executive summary and the decision table. Please keep replies terse (bullets + owner/ETA).

Neha Kapoor
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
